title: The Annual fair in the square
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：annual　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 annual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the tailor wrote of ① an annual fair in the square in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so annual that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the annual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the annual fair in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too annual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the annual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an annual report to the council, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as annual as the report to the council they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was annual or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something annual, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite annual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the annual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, in the rain, she wrote of another annual fair in the square in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less annual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The annual report to the council that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the annual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 一年一度（前置定语 an annual fair in the square：1965 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件一年一度的集市）
B. adj. 一年一度／年度（两处加强说法：so annual that … 与 no less annual than …）
C. adj. 一年一度／年度（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 一年一度（表语 too annual to do：母亲觉得它太一年一度，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 年度（前置定语 an annual report to the council：叔叔把整件事称作一桩年度的报告）
F. adj. 年度（同级比较 as annual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩呈给议会的报告相比）
G. adj. 年度（后置定语 something annual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 年度（受程度副词修饰 quite annual：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an annual fair in the square
the annual fair in the square that
an annual report to the council
The annual report to the council that

answers.why: annual 意为“一年一度”，1965 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件一年一度的集市”，此处作前置定语 an annual fair in the square。
annual 意为“一年一度”，此处用 so annual that 结构，说它一年一度到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
annual 意为“一年一度”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的一年一度广场上的集市，等于最高级的说法。
annual 意为“一年一度”，母亲认为这件东西“太一年一度了，谁也用不上”，too annual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
annual 意为“年度”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩年度的报告”，此处作前置定语 an annual report to the council。
annual 意为“年度”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩呈给议会的报告一样年度”，同级比较用 as annual as。
annual 意为“年度”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“年度的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something annual。
annual 意为“年度”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当年度”，quite 修饰原级 annual。
annual 意为“年度”，no less annual than 表示“其年度不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之年度不亚于任何人的预料。
annual 意为“年度”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的年度报告”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件一年一度的集市。（an annual fair in the square）
它一年一度到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so annual that …）
母亲觉得它太一年一度，谁也用不上。（too annual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩年度的报告。（an annual report to the council）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩呈给议会的报告一样年度。（as annual as …）
到了 1972 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件年度的东西。（something annual）
answers: In 1965 the tailor wrote of an annual fair in the square in the order.
It was so annual that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too annual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an annual report to the council.
He said nobody would call it as annual as the report to the council they had once had.
By 1972 the order asked for nothing but something annual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 annual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the tailor wrote of an annual fair in the square in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the annual fair in the square that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too annual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an annual report to the council, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite annual, and everybody laughed.
The annual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
